feeds.title: Life in Norway » Food & Drink
feeds.description: This section of Life in Norway features articles on Food and Drinks. Dive into posts about traditional salted and dried dishes, through to modern 'New Nordic' fine dining. Life in Norway is your English language guide to all things Norway: From history and culture to practical guides on relocation, finding a job, and learning the language.

feeds.title: Travel Food Atlas » Norway
feeds.description: Norwegian recipes, foods, cuisines, dishes, and blogs. Discover a whole host of travel inspiration and food delicacies from Norway. Travel Food Atlas is a travel & food blog dedicated to exploring cultures, local foods, delicacies, recipes, and travel experiences all over the world.

feeds.title: Det glade kjøkken
feeds.description: Det glade kjøkken, aka The Happy Kitchen, is a food blog run by food hobbyist Rolf-Anders with a main focus on simple and good everyday food, as well as some weekend recipes that should only be made for and enjoyed. Rolf cooks and shares everything from healthy and good everyday food, hoping to inspire readers to follow a healthier, happier routine.

feeds.title: Eating Out In Stavanger
feeds.description: EatingOutInStavanger is a food blog about Stavanger, Norway. Started by food enthusiasts Nikki & Gaard, It aims to keep the reader updated on the Stavanger restaurant scene and write about the best places to enjoy good food and good wine. Stay tuned for some great Food places and Dining experiences in the city.

feeds.title: Scandinavian Cookbook
feeds.description: Norwegian-raised Silvia loves cooking and traveling across Norway. Here, she shares translations of her Norwegian mother's recipes, along with her own tweaks and suggestions. The blog Scandinavian Cookbook documents her cooking skills, little insights and trivia about Norway's food culture.

feeds.title: A Frog in the Fjord » Food
feeds.description: Read all articles divulging the traditional culinary delights of Norwegian food cuisine in A Frog in the Fjord blog by Anna Julia Granberg, a French lady living in Norway. Ana started this blog as a resource for foreigners like her face when trying to adapt to a new culture, language, or country; to help them understand the Norwegian culture and blend in.

feeds.title: Arctic Grub Blog
feeds.description: Arctic Grub Blog sees Wine consultant & educator Sunny Gandara educating readers about Norwegian and Scandinavian food, drink, and culture. She talks about the fabulous country, culture, and cuisine of Norway and showcases how plant-based dishes can illustrate the wealth of what the North has to offer food-wise.

feeds.title: Julie B. Christensen Blog
feeds.description: Julie B. Christensen writes in her blog about restaurants: including Where to Eat in Stavanger, tips for Oslo and Copenhagen, and Arendal. Find trendy Restaurant reviews, food recommendations, City Food & guides, and other useful tips.

feeds.title: North Wild Kitchen
feeds.description: North Wild Kitchen takes an intimate look at Norwegian cooking through the lens of tradition, local ingredients, seasons, local producers, and simple gatherings. Dive into the heart of Norwegian food culture with a trove of juicy recipes, traditions, and stories from Norway.

feeds.title: Nordic Provisions » Recipes
feeds.description: Nordic Provisions' Recipe segment brings you both new recipes from the Nordic region as well as recipes of traditional Nordic food. The writers hope to showcase the best produce the north has to offer and give you an insight into all the great things going on in the region.
